findings.title: One crowded area holds near-identical records
findings.detail: one area of the map holds 5% of placed records, and those records average 0.93 cosine similarity to each other — that is one thing written out many times rather than one subject covered many ways, and shingle-based duplicate detection cannot see it
findings.fix: Inspect that region's examples; if they are one template, sample it down rather than deduplicating.
